title: A Control-Theoretic Approach for Resource-Aware Consensus in Multi-Agent AI
summary: Large language model multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) rely on inter-agent communication to solve complex reasoning tasks, yet rigorous guarantees relating consensus performance to computational resources remain limited. Here, we present a novel way to characterize collective belief dynamics as a discrete-time switched system in which communication topologies have distinct consensus-contraction rates and token costs.
